text:
Anouk Rivera: hey folks! i'm Anouk (she/her) — thrilled to join Redwood Inference as an infra engineer. i live in Barcelona, love home espresso, small thermal-camera tinkering (yes, i take silly photos of my cat :cat2:), and i'm slowly building a tiny tabletop fern garden. happy to trade coffee tips and regional tapas recs. i'll be mostly on eng-infra channels but dropping by here to say hi :wave:

Kai: welcome Anouk!! espresso tips appreciated. where do you pull water from? :grin:

Anouk Rivera: @Kai i use a refurbished La Pavoni and a filtered jug. water temp fiddling is my evening therapy. also open to remote brunch swaps — i make decent empanadas :yum:

Samir: welcome!! if you ever want to nerd about batch schedulers or thermal cams in racks i'm your person. also, cat photos mandatory :thumbsup:

Harper: love the fern garden idea. we have a plants channel if you want to post progress pics :) :seedling:

emily: welcome aboard Anouk — quick FYI, onboarding lunch tomorrow 12:30 PT in #new-hires (zoom link in calendar). also tagging welcome-bot for equipment checklist :sparkles:

welcome-bot: Welcome Anouk Rivera! Your laptop order is Processing. Expected delivery: 3 business days. If you need early access to a dev box DM infra-ops.

Anouk Rivera: thanks all! i'll pop into the plants and eng-infra channels. and yes, cat pics incoming. also happy to help with weekend espresso workshop if people are interested :coffee:

Kai: sign me up :raised_hands:

Samir: me too

Harper: count me in — would love to learn tamping technique.
